source: The research index refresh follows git's own hourly maintenance prefetch of main, which this repo registers through deploy/wsl/lifecycle.sh (`git maintenance start`).

rows.name: openviking_index_period_minutes
rows.source: git-maintenance(1), git 2.53.0: the prefetch task runs on the hourly schedule; the git-maintenance@hourly.timer git writes here has OnCalendar=*-*-* 1..23:00:00.

rows.name: openviking_index_offset_minutes
rows.source: After git's hourly prefetch at minute 0 (git-maintenance@hourly.timer, OnCalendar=*-*-* 1..23:00:00), so a run reads the main that prefetch just fetched.
